analysis:
This PR changes only local, read-only operator diagnostics. Three call sites now read the displayed authorization from DaemonStateFile via displayedProviderAuthorization; previously they used currentProviderAuthorization. They also pass currentProviderAuthorization as removalAuthorization into ProviderAuthorizationReadiness.summary. The call sites are DoctorRunner.swift head 34-35 and 75-76, DoctorCommand.swift head 358-363 and 414-415, and StatusCommand.swift head 135-140.

Security relevance: these values only drive doctor/status output and the doctor exit code. They do not reach coordinator routing, the TB-011 serving-authorization grant, or the TB-002 wire protocol. Under T-052, any locally displayed authorization is advisory. The coordinator and platform remain authoritative for serving permission, and an adversarial operator (ADV-001) can already edit the state file.

One behavioral change: appAttestAuthorized is now derived from the displayed authorization rather than the current one. This suppresses MDM, readiness and enrollment hints and can change the pass/warn level (DoctorRunner 36, 65, 74, 107; DoctorCommand 363, 382-388, 413). If displayedProviderAuthorization returns a stale or removed grant, doctor could show a misleading pass to a benign operator. That would be a diagnostics-accuracy issue, not a security regression, because hasCurrentAppAttestAuthorization(now:) still checks expiry on the displayed value.

Integration should verify the implementations of DaemonState.displayedProviderAuthorization and ProviderAuthorizationReadiness.summary(removalAuthorization:), which are not in this batch. Check that the displayed value is bound to coordinatorURL and to the current daemon/connection. Check that the summary clearly labels a removed or revoked grant (T-053) and does not overclaim serving eligibility (T-058 diagnostics misstating trust). Neither implementation was supplied, so this conclusion is limited to the call sites. No changes to secrets, network or authorization enforcement were observed.
